column1: # Every row of architecture section 8.4 (required interruption matrix) and every
# required concurrent interleaving names the exact test that proves it, plus the
# deterministic coordination boundary that test targets.  The registry is
# mechanically enforced by tests/unit/check-interruption-matrix.sh, which is run
#   key           slug of the architecture section 8.4 boundary, or interleaving name
#   suite         bats suite under tests/unit/ that contains the proving test
#   coordination  named fault-hook boundary the test parks or crashes at

column4: a writer killed before the candidate owner write leaves diagnosable private debris
a writer killed after the candidate flush leaves no authoritative lock
the kernel releases the transition guard when its process dies
repair killed before the quarantine rename leaves the exact lock unchanged
a releaser killed during release validation leaves the exact lock unchanged
repair killed after the quarantine rename leaves evidence and permits acquisition
a releaser killed after the release quarantine rename preserves evidence
a writer killed during private publication leaves reported debris that never commits
a writer killed after the event rename leaves one committed revision counted once
a writer killed during the ledger temporary write keeps committed events authoritative
a writer killed after the ledger replacement agrees with committed events
two real acquisitions serialize on the shared transition guard and exactly one publishes
an acquisition holding the transition guard blocks repair until it publishes a live owner
a blocked acquirer publishes the moment the holder releases
repair and acquisition cannot interleave under the shared transition guard
a real contending process times out boundedly and removes only its candidate
a stale handle cannot remove the replacement lock published after owner death
